missingControls.title: Canonical production hostname does not resolve
missingControls.detail: thebackhalf.org / www.thebackhalf.org NXDOMAIN. Public TLS and cookie domain for the brand hostname cannot be verified. Production currently lives on the Vercel host. Row 75 remains NOT READY. DNS was not changed by this audit.

missingControls.title: Stripe webhook secret not configured in production
missingControls.detail: POST /api/stripe/webhook returns 503 webhook_not_configured. Paid-order fulfillment cannot be signature-verified until STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set. Combined with TEST-SANDBOX key class, live payment processing is not production-ready.

missingControls.title: npm audit: 11 high, 1 moderate on installed tree
missingControls.detail: Lockfile next@16.2.12 inherits PostCSS and sharp advisories; puppeteer@24.x inherits extract-zip / browsers advisories; also brace-expansion, fast-uri, js-yaml, nanoid, hono (moderate). Fixes were not applied. Next bump to 16.3.3 is a semver-minor product change and needs a dedicated Imani engineering item, not a silent patch in this audit.

missingControls.title: No brute-force rate limit on login or registration
missingControls.detail: Invalid login returns generic 401. There is no per-IP or per-account lockout. Password-reset cooldown is 60s only.

missingControls.title: Application security headers incomplete
missingControls.detail: HSTS is present via Vercel. next.config.ts and vercel.json set no CSP, X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. x-powered-by: Next.js is emitted.

missingControls.title: Password-reset tokens stored in plaintext; sessions survive reset
missingControls.detail: Tokens are UUIDs in Postgres. A DB reader can redeem a live token. Successful reset does not invalidate bh-session JWTs already issued.

missingControls.title: Cloudflare account 2FA inactive
missingControls.detail: Row 74 Founder-accepted residual risk. Not converted to PASS. DNS/registrar lock remains client transfer prohibited. This audit did not enable 2FA and did not change DNS.

missingControls.title: JWT role used for middleware gating for up to 30 days
missingControls.detail: Mutations re-check the store. Route access can lag a role revocation until re-login or expiry.

missingControls.title: Unauthenticated analytics and marketing ingest have no rate limit
missingControls.detail: /api/analytics/event and /api/marketing/session are expected public beacons. They can be spammed. Payloads are sanitized; they do not grant admin access.

missingControls.title: Urgent Founder SMS not configured
missingControls.detail: Twilio / FOUNDER_NOTIFY_SMS absent. Security incidents rely on dashboard + email. Not a remote-code issue.
